title: Contingency
intro: September: typhoon risk in Đà Nẵng is highest-probability disruption; China visa/entry is second. $20K budget allows rebooking flexibility. Verify all contacts before travel (as of May 2026).

tables.caption: Đà Nẵng Typhoon Levels
rows: Continue plan; cancel sea activities; Ancient Town OK (covered walkways)
Cancel Cham Islands; reschedule outdoor; stay at resort (spa/pool)
Resort is shelter; do not move cities; storms pass 12–18 hrs

tables.caption: Missed Flight Recovery
rows: Gate agent for next flight; hold Metropole

bullets.heading: Weather Pivot — Beijing Rain
items: Forbidden City: covered walkways; Summer Palace: Long Corridor light rain only
Pivot: Beijing Capital Museum (indoor, free) or Parkview Green Mall

bullets.heading: Sick in Vietnam
items: Mild: rest 1 day Hanoi; rebook domestic flight; push resort arrival
Serious: call insurer 24/7 FIRST; Vinmec Hanoi +84-24-3974-3556; do not fly with high fever
Đà Nẵng resort days absorb 1 lost day

bullets.heading: Visa / Entry Denied
items: China PEK: stay at immigration; supervisor; hotel + return flight + visa letter
Backup route: Seoul or Tokyo (visa-free) then start Vietnam instead
Vietnam: printed e-visa; VOA letter fallback if needed

bullets.heading: Lost Passport
items: Police report immediately (China 110 / Vietnam 113) with official stamp
US Embassy emergency passport 1–2 business days; $170; digital passport copy from cloud
Notify insurer; hold flights until replacement confirmed

bullets.heading: Budget Overrun in China
items: Cut Silk Market buys; Da Dong → market duck (~¥150 vs ¥400/person)
Private Great Wall car → shared shuttle (~¥80 vs ¥400 RT)
Don't cut Vietnam resort—reduce Hội An shopping instead

bullets.heading: Other Scenarios
items: Split itinerary: vote per profile; share FindMy; Grab/DiDi for solo days
Luggage lost: file at claim; carry-on has 2 days clothes + all docs/meds; insurance receipts >6 hrs
DAD airport closed (typhoon): train via 12go.asia; insurer trip interruption clause
Political: State Dept 1-888-407-4747; shelter at hotel; STEP registration

callouts.text: Typhoon — monitor weather.com, NOAA Pacific Typhoon Center, NOAA alerts for Da Nang
Insurance: World Nomads or Allianz; book day of first flight; typhoon cancellation + medevac + baggage delay
Trip insurance: activate if flight delay >4 hrs; document boarding passes and gate notices
